message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | Each round ends when a player discards their last card. The other players tally the values of the cards left in their hands; those totals are added to the winner’s score. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 25 × Red, 25 × Yellow, 25 × Green, 25 × Blue + 8 × Wild + 8 × Wild Draw Four. | Shuffle the deck thoroughly. | | **Setup** | • Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a Draw Two, the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | | **Turn Order** | Clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | | **Playing a Card** | • On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard.
• If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise, you risk a challenge.) | | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. | | | **UNO Violation** | If you forget to say “UNO” and another player calls it out before you play your next card, you must draw **two** penalty cards. | | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | | **Scoring** | • Add up the point values of the cards left in each opponent’s hand:
 – Number cards: face value.
 – Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points.
 – Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points.
• Add that total to the winner’s score. | | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the target score (commonly 500) wins the game. | | | **House Variations** | • **No Wild Draw Four Challenge** – Simplifies play.
• **“Stacking”** – Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing.
• **“Seven‑Zero”** – 7 lets you swap hands; 0 reverses direction.
• **“Jump‑In”** – If you have an exact duplicate of the top card, you can play it immediately, even out of turn. | | --- ### Quick Play‑through Example 1. **Deal**: 7 cards each, flip top card → 5 Red. 2. **Player A** (first to play) has a 5 Blue and a Skip Red. - Plays 5 Blue (matches number). 3. **Player B** has a 5 Red. - Plays 5 Red (matches color). 4. **Player C** has a Wild Draw Four. - Plays Wild Draw Four, chooses **Green**. - Player D draws four cards and skips turn. 5. **Player E** continues, etc. --- ### Tips & Strategy - **Keep a balanced hand**: Try to hold a mix of colors so you’re not stuck. - **Save Wilds**: Use them when you’re low on cards or to change the color to your advantage. - **Watch opponents’ “UNO” calls**: If they forget, you can force them to draw two. - **Use Reverse strategically**: In a 2‑player game, Reverse becomes a Skip. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
